asset.visual_event: 格尔曼·斯帕罗在海上舱室的狭窄旧镜前完成身份调整；本人保持稳定，镜中脸部出现克制而轻微的身份错位。

provenance.prompt_summary: Vertical 2:3 painterly dark-fantasy scene in a cramped sea cabin: dark maritime coat and hat, narrow damp mirror, subtle identity mismatch, cold moonlight and restrained warm lamp, one coherent narrative event.
provenance.negative_constraints: No card frame, nameplate, sequence numeral, pathway emblem, logo, watermark, readable writing, pseudo-text, collage, extra full character, marionette language, gray fog throne, history projection, miracle, godlike aura, body horror or gunfight.
processing_chain: no frame, text or emblem compositing

engineering.color_space: RGB (reported by sips; project target is sRGB)

observations: 主体、镜面与海上舱室属于同一连续场景。
镜面保留轻微脸部身份差异，未表现为剧烈变形。
未观察到卡框、序列数字、途径徽记或可读文字。
未观察到木偶线、灰雾王座、历史投影或神性光环。
remaining_risks: 这是候选备用物料，人物细节与镜面语义仍需正式单卡设计和人工视觉批准。
1024×1536 是本次原生画布，不代表项目最终 2048×3072 卡面交付。
